analysis.animeFromTheStart: Anime is analysed differently from the start. Add the videos as a new anime project instead.
analysis.facesNotFound: The faces of this media aren't found yet.
analysis.shotsNotFound: Shots of this media aren't found yet.

cast.characterGone: This character doesn't exist any more.
cast.keptChanging: The cast kept changing while it was being grouped. Try again.
cast.notInCast: This character isn't in the cast any more.

db.busy: Another program is using AutoScene's data. Close it and try again.
db.cannotOpen: AutoScene couldn't open its data. Check that the drive is connected.
db.damaged: AutoScene's data file is damaged. Details are in the log.
db.driveFailed: The drive couldn't be read or written. Details are in the log.
db.generic: AutoScene couldn't read or save its data. Details are in the log.
db.permission: AutoScene doesn't have permission to open its data.
db.readOnly: AutoScene can't save its data there: the drive or folder is read-only.
db.tooNew: This project was made by a newer version of AutoScene. Update AutoScene to open it.
db.upgradeFailed: AutoScene couldn't update this project's data. Details are in the log.

episode.indexDamaged: Its frame index is damaged. Index it again.
episode.moved: {{name}} can't be found. Was it moved?
episode.noPreviewNeeded: This file doesn't need a separate preview.

preview.failed: The preview couldn't be prepared for this file.
preview.missing: The preview file is missing. Preparing it again…
preview.needed: This format needs a preview copy for frame-accurate playback.

episode.previewRefused: This episode's preview can't be shown. Prepare it again.
episode.stillStopping: The work on this episode is still stopping. Try again in a moment.

csv.mixedRates: Clips of different frame rates can't share one cut list.

edl.mixedRates: Clips of different frame rates can't share one EDL.
edl.pastMidnight: {{name}} runs past midnight in its episode's timecode, which an EDL can't hold.
edl.tooFast: An EDL holds at most 100 frames a second. Save a cut list (CSV) instead.
edl.tooLong: These clips run longer than the 23 hours an EDL can hold.

export.episodeNotIndexed: An episode of this export isn't indexed.
export.episodesRemoved: This export's episodes were removed from the project.
export.fullPath: Choose a full folder path for the export.

lossless.allFfv1: These pictures can't be stored exactly as HEVC, so they're kept as FFV1 in an MKV: DaVinci Resolve and VLC open it, After Effects doesn't.
lossless.apart: Bit-Perfect makes a file per shot here: {{why}}.
lossless.colours: their episodes' colours are tagged differently
lossless.pictures: their episodes' pictures differ in size or format
lossless.someFfv1: Some of these pictures can't be stored exactly as HEVC, so they're kept as FFV1 in an MKV: DaVinci Resolve and VLC open it, After Effects doesn't.
lossless.sound: their episodes' sound differs in its rate or channels

export.noneExported: None of the clips could be exported.
export.noneFinished: No clip of this export has finished yet.
export.notJoined: It couldn't be joined into the file.

file.badLocation: AutoScene can't use that location. Choose a file or folder on this computer or on a network share.
file.badName: That name can't be used for a file.
file.cantShow: That file or folder couldn't be shown.
file.generic: A file couldn't be read or written. Details are in the log.
file.gone: That file or folder isn't there any more.
file.inUse: The file is open in another program. Close it there and try again.
file.missing: A file or folder AutoScene needs isn't there any more.
file.notOurs: AutoScene only shows its own files and folders.
file.permission: AutoScene doesn't have permission to use that file or folder.
file.tooBig: The file is too big for that disk.

internal: Something went wrong. Details are in the log.

library.fullPath: Choose a full folder path for the library.
library.notImported: {{name}} can't be imported: its name, or the name of a folder it's in, isn't valid Unicode. Rename it and add it again.
library.notImportedMore_one: {{name}} and {{count}} more can't be imported: their names, or the names of folders they're in, aren't valid Unicode. Rename them and add them again.
library.notImportedMore_other: {{name}} and {{count}} more can't be imported: their names, or the names of folders they're in, aren't valid Unicode. Rename them and add them again.
library.notUnicode: Its name, or the name of a folder it's in, isn't valid Unicode. Rename it to import it.

media.toolsMissing: AutoScene's video tools are missing. Reinstall AutoScene.
media.toolsTooOld: AutoScene's video tools are out of date. Reinstall AutoScene.

name.didYouMean: “{{token}}” isn't a name part. Did you mean {{part}}?
name.notForFile: “{{token}}” names a shot, not the file. The file's name can use {{parts}} and {{last}}.
name.unknownPart: “{{token}}” isn't a name part. Use {{parts}} or {{last}}.

anilist.busy: AniList is busy. Try again in a few minutes.
anilist.unreachable: AniList can't be reached right now. Check the internet connection and try again.

names.animatedOnly: Names are looked up for anime and animation only.
names.castChanged: The cast changed; match the portraits again.

fandom.busy: Wikidata or Fandom is busy. Try again in a few minutes.
fandom.noFilm: Wikidata has no film Q{{id}} with a Fandom wiki.
fandom.noWiki: No Fandom wiki was found for {{title}}.
fandom.unreachable: Wikidata or Fandom can't be reached right now. Check the internet connection and try again.

names.footageChanged: The footage changed meanwhile; search again.
names.noLongerWaiting: These names no longer wait: the series or the cast changed.
names.turnOn: Turn on character names in Settings first.

tvmaze.busy: TVmaze is busy. Try again in a few minutes.
tvmaze.unreachable: TVmaze can't be reached right now. Check the internet connection and try again.

names.typeFilm: Type the name of the film to look for.
names.typeSeries: Type the name of the series to look for.

pack.changed: The pack changed meanwhile. Check it and export again.
pack.empty: There's nothing in the pack to export.
pack.waitsForFilter: The pack waits for “{{title}}” to check its shots.

plugin.eventRunsItself: An event runs by itself, once it is turned on.
plugin.filterRunsInBuilder: A shot filter checks shots from the scenepack builder.
plugin.hostFailed: Plugins couldn't start. Details are in the log.
plugin.noLogYet: It hasn't run yet, so it has no log.
plugin.notAFilter: That isn't a plugin's shot filter.
plugin.notAPackAction: That isn't a plugin's pack action.
plugin.packActionRunsInBuilder: A pack action saves a scenepack from its builder.
plugin.pageNeedsProject: Open a project to see this page.
plugin.reviewClosed: This review was closed. Open the plugin again.
plugin.reviewExpired: This plugin waited too long to be installed. Open it again.
plugin.saveNameTooLong: That file name is too long. Choose a shorter one.
plugin.saveRunnable: A plugin can't save a program, a script or a shortcut.

project.alreadyInProject: That file is already in the project, as {{name}}.
project.folderMissing: The project folder {{path}} is missing. Was it moved or deleted?
project.stillStopping: The work on this project is still stopping. Try again in a moment.

relink.codec: Its picture is stored as {{codec}} instead of {{was}}.
relink.container: It's another kind of video file.
relink.frameRate: It plays at another frame rate.
relink.picture: At the same moment it shows another picture.

system.logsFailed: The logs folder couldn't be opened.
system.menuKeysFailed: The menu's keys couldn't be changed.

update.gone: That update is no longer available.
